title: Ebola Outbreak in DRC Becomes Fastest-Growing in History
subtitle: Health officials face major challenges as the virus spreads rapidly through eastern provinces.

summary.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is currently facing its fastest-growing Ebola outbreak ever recorded. With over 3,300 confirmed cases, the virus has spread across five eastern provinces. Conflict and high population density are making it difficult for health workers to control the disease. Experts are now testing a new vaccine to help stop the spread. International teams are working together to manage the situation and protect local communities.
summary.zh: 剛果民主共和國目前正面臨史上擴散速度最快的伊波拉疫情。確診病例已超過三千三百起，病毒並已蔓延至東部五個省份。衝突與高人口密度使得衛生工作者難以控制疫情。專家目前正在測試一種新型疫苗以協助阻止病毒擴散。國際團隊正攜手合作，共同管理疫情並保護當地社區。

paragraphs.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is facing a serious health crisis as the current Ebola outbreak becomes the fastest-growing in the history of the virus. According to The Guardian, the country has recorded 3,360 confirmed cases. With 1,487 deaths reported, the fatality rate—the percentage of people who die after catching the disease—is estimated at about 45 percent. This situation is approaching the record set during the 2018-2020 outbreak, which saw 3,470 infections.
paragraphs.zh: 剛果民主共和國 (Democratic Republic of the Congo, DRC) 正面臨嚴重的健康危機，目前的伊波拉病毒疫情已成為該病毒史上擴散速度最快的一次。根據《衛報》(The Guardian) 報導，該國已記錄到三千三百六十起確診病例。在通報的一千四百八十七起死亡案例中，致死率（即感染後死亡的人數比例）估計約為百分之四十五。此情況正逼近二零一八年至二零二零年疫情期間所創下的三千四百七十起感染紀錄。

paragraphs.en: Since the outbreak was officially declared on May 15, the virus has spread across five provinces in the east of the country. Prof Pierre Akilimali, who leads the national response, noted that the situation is very complex. He explained that factors such as ongoing conflict, local mining activities, and high population density make it much harder to stop the virus compared to previous outbreaks. In the health zones of Bunia and Rwampara, officials report between 100 and 150 new cases every single week.
paragraphs.zh: 自五月十五日正式宣布疫情爆發以來，病毒已擴散至該國東部的五個省份。負責領導國家應對工作的皮耶爾·阿基利馬利教授 (Prof Pierre Akilimali) 指出，情況非常複雜。他解釋說，持續的衝突、當地的採礦活動以及高人口密度等因素，使得遏止病毒的難度遠高於以往的疫情。在布尼亞 (Bunia) 與瓦姆帕拉 (Rwampara) 的衛生區，官員通報每週新增病例數介於一百至一百五十起之間。

paragraphs.en: For the people living in these areas, the impact is severe. Deborah Nzuva, a local mother, told The Guardian that life in her province feels like it is coming to a standstill. She described the situation as very difficult, noting that the community was already struggling before the virus arrived. Traders in the city of Bunia also expressed deep concern, saying that the outbreak is causing great distress and stopping important local development projects.
paragraphs.zh: 對於居住在這些地區的民眾而言，影響極為嚴重。當地一位母親黛博拉·恩祖瓦 (Deborah Nzuva) 向《衛報》表示，她所在省份的生活彷彿陷入停滯。她形容情況非常艱難，並提到在病毒來襲之前，社區就已經在掙扎求生。布尼亞市的商人們也表達了深切的擔憂，表示疫情造成了巨大的痛苦，並阻礙了重要的在地發展計畫。

paragraphs.en: Health experts are working under significant pressure to contain the disease. Dr. Justus Nsio, an incident manager for the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, stated that the outbreak was detected too late. Because of this delay, teams must work much harder to catch up and stop the virus from spreading further. To help, the government has built more than 20 treatment centres and set up local laboratories to test for the virus. They have also increased the number of community workers who help identify new cases.
paragraphs.zh: 衛生專家正承受著巨大的壓力以控制疫情。非洲疾病管制暨預防中心 (Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention) 的事件經理賈斯圖斯·恩西奧醫生 (Dr. Justus Nsio) 表示，疫情發現得太晚。由於這項延誤，團隊必須付出加倍努力來追趕進度，防止病毒進一步擴散。為了提供協助，政府已建立了二十多個治療中心，並設立了在地實驗室以檢測病毒。他們也增加了社區工作人員的數量，以協助識別新增病例。

paragraphs.en: One of the most important steps in the response is the development of a new vaccine. Because there is no standard treatment for this specific strain of the virus, clinical trials—research studies to see if a medicine is safe and effective—began in early July. Prof Placide Mbala, who leads laboratory operations, reported that about 20 people had joined the trials by mid-July. These tests could take up to four months to complete. While the work is ongoing, experts are looking for ways to speed up the process.
paragraphs.zh: 應對措施中最重要的一步是研發新型疫苗。由於針對此特定病毒株尚無標準治療方法，臨床試驗（即評估藥物安全性與有效性的研究）已於七月初展開。負責領導實驗室運作的普拉西德·姆巴拉教授 (Prof Placide Mbala) 回報，截至七月中旬，已有約二十人參與試驗。這些測試可能需要長達四個月才能完成。在工作持續進行的同時，專家們正尋求加快流程的方法。

paragraphs.en: International cooperation is also playing a key role in the response. Uganda, which recently declared that its own Ebola outbreak is over, has sent experts to the DRC. These specialists are working alongside Congolese teams, particularly in border areas like Tchomia and Kasenyi, to share knowledge and support the containment efforts.
paragraphs.zh: 國際合作也在應對行動中扮演關鍵角色。近期宣布伊波拉疫情結束的烏干達，已派遣專家前往剛果民主共和國。這些專業人員正與剛果團隊並肩作戰，特別是在喬米亞 (Tchomia) 與卡森伊 (Kasenyi) 等邊境地區，共同分享知識並支援防疫工作。

paragraphs.en: Despite these efforts, officials warn that the road ahead remains long. Prof Akilimali emphasized that it is still difficult to know when the outbreak will reach its peak. He urged the public to play an active role by seeking medical advice immediately if they feel sick or suspect they have been exposed to the virus. By working together, local authorities and international partners hope to achieve a better outcome, though they acknowledge that the race against time is far from over.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管做出了這些努力，官員仍警告前方的道路依然漫長。阿基利馬利教授強調，目前仍難以判斷疫情何時會達到高峰。他呼籲大眾積極配合，若感到身體不適或懷疑自己曾接觸病毒，應立即尋求醫療建議。透過地方當局與國際夥伴的共同努力，他們希望能達成更好的結果，儘管他們也承認，這場與時間的賽跑遠未結束。

keyTerms.definitionEn: A situation in which all activity or movement has stopped.
keyTerms.noteZh: 此詞常與 come to 搭配，形容活動完全停止。文中：Deborah Nzuva, a local mother, told The Guardian that life in her province feels like it is coming to a standstill.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To reach the same point or level as someone or something else after being behind.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡指因為延誤而需要加倍努力以達到應有的進度。文中：Because of this delay, teams must work much harder to catch up and stop the virus from spreading further.

keyTerms.definitionEn: The future or the process of achieving something that is still to come.
keyTerms.noteZh: 並非指實際的道路，而是比喻未來將面臨的過程或困難。文中：Despite these efforts, officials warn that the road ahead remains long.

quiz.question: According to the article, what is the fatality rate of the current Ebola outbreak in the DRC?
quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，文中明確指出「the fatality rate... is estimated at about 45 percent」。選項 A、C、D 皆與文中數據不符。此題旨在測試讀者是否能從文中精確提取數據，而非僅是掃描關鍵字。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why might the current Ebola outbreak be more challenging to control than previous ones?

options.A: Because the virus has mutated into a more deadly strain
options.B: Because there are no treatment centres available in the country
options.C: Because environmental and social instability hinder containment efforts
options.D: Because international organizations have refused to provide assistance

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。第二段提到衝突、採礦活動及高人口密度使得防疫工作變得極為複雜。選項 A 文中未提及病毒變異；選項 B 與第四段提到的「built more than 20 treatment centres」矛盾；選項 D 與第六段提到的國際合作事實不符。透過整合第二段與第四段的資訊，可推論社會環境因素是防疫的巨大阻礙。

quiz.question: In the third paragraph, what does the phrase 'life in her province feels like it is coming to a standstill' imply?

options.A: Life is becoming more dangerous and violent
options.B: Daily activities and economic progress have stopped
options.C: People are moving to different provinces to stay safe
options.D: The government has imposed a strict curfew

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。standstill 在此處意指「停滯」或「陷入僵局」。根據上下文，當地居民與商人提到發展項目被迫中止，顯示生活步調因疫情而停擺。選項 A 未直接對應 standstill 的語意；選項 C 文中未提及人口遷移；選項 D 雖與防疫相關，但文中未提到具體宵禁措施，僅描述經濟與生活停滯的狀態。

quiz.question: What is the central message of this article?

options.A: The DRC government has successfully contained the Ebola outbreak
options.B: The Ebola virus is primarily spreading through mining activities
options.C: Clinical trials for a new vaccine are the only way to stop the virus
options.D: The DRC is struggling with a complex and rapidly growing Ebola crisis that requires ongoing effort

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。全文重點在於描述疫情的嚴重性、防疫面臨的挑戰（如衝突與延遲發現）、採取的措施（疫苗、國際合作）以及未來的艱難道路。選項 A 與文意完全相反；選項 B 僅是導致複雜化的其中一個因素，非主旨；選項 C 將疫苗過度簡化為唯一方法，忽略了防疫的其他多重面向。
